name: Sculptor (imbue-ai) — Parallel Claude Code Agents in Isolated Docker Containers; v0.38.0 June 28, Show HN
hook: Sculptor is Imbue's open-source desktop app (Mac Apple Silicon + Linux) that sandboxes each Claude Code agent in its own Docker container — spin up parallel workspaces, review diffs, merge back to main, all without leaving the app. The built-in terminal and GitHub PR integration mean you stay in flow across sessions. v0.38.0 shipped June 28, 2026; Show HN posted same day. Labeled 'experimental research preview'. 189 stars and climbing.

name: code-review-graph — 19k Stars; 82× Median Token Reduction via Tree-sitter AST Graph + MCP (38×–528× Benchmarked)
hook: code-review-graph builds a persistent structural map of your codebase (Tree-sitter AST → SQLite graph), then exposes 30+ MCP tools so Claude reads only the nodes that matter for each review. Across 6 real repos the median token reduction is 82× (fastapi 528×, gin 91×, flask 71×, httpx 38×). Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Kiro, and Copilot. 19,000 stars, v2.3.6 (June 10).

name: Claude Code v2.1.196 — Org Default Models, Readable Session Names, Clickable File Attachments (June 29)
hook: Claude Code v2.1.196 (June 29, 2026) adds three quality-of-life improvements: organizations can now set a default model for all members; new sessions get readable human-friendly names instead of UUIDs; and file attachments in chat become clickable (Cmd/Ctrl-click reveals the file in Finder/Explorer). MCP server approval security tightened. Background session reliability improved. Previous digest covered v2.1.195.

name: Piebald-AI/claude-code-system-prompts v2.1.197 — 11.5k Stars; 515+ Prompts, Updated June 30 Within Minutes of Release
hook: Piebald-AI's prompt-tracking repo follows every Claude Code release within minutes, extracting the main system prompt, 27 builtin tool descriptions, sub-agent prompts (Plan/Explore/Task), and ~40 system reminders from compiled source. Prompt count grew from 350 to 515 (+165) when v2.1.196 shipped; v2.1.197 was indexed June 30. Companion tool tweakcc lets you patch any of these into your npm or native Claude Code install. 11,500 stars.
install: See README (browse prompts; use tweakcc to patch)

name: claude-code-plugins-plus-skills (jeremylongshore) — 2.5k Stars; 425 Plugins + 2,810 Skills + ccpi CLI + tonsofskills.com Marketplace
hook: One canonical catalog: 425 spec-validated plugins and 2,810 skills installable via the ccpi CLI or Claude's built-in /plugin command. Every package is graded on an 8-field rubric (name, description, allowed tools, version, author, license, compatibility, tags) and browsable at tonsofskills.com. 19 categories, 30 contributors. NPM download metrics refresh daily. 2,500 stars.

name: VILA-Lab/Dive-into-Claude-Code — 1.7k Stars; Reverse-Engineered 512K-Line Source; Only 1.6% Is AI Logic
hook: Researchers at VILA-Lab reverse-engineered Claude Code v2.1.88 from the March 2026 npm source-map leak (512,000 lines, 1,906 TypeScript files) and published arXiv:2604.14228. The headline finding: only 1.6% of the codebase is AI decision logic — the other 98.4% is deterministic infrastructure (permission gates, context management, tool routing, recovery). Five human values map to 13 design principles and concrete implementation choices. Multilingual analysis (EN/JA/KO/ZH). 1,700 stars.

name: rohitg00/awesome-claude-code-toolkit — 2.2k Stars; 135 Agents, 176+ Plugins, 42 Commands, 14 MCP Configs in One Repo
hook: The most comprehensive single-repo Claude Code toolkit by count: 135 agents, 35 curated skills (+ 400,000 via SkillKit), 42 commands, 176+ plugins, 20 hooks, 15 rules, 7 templates, 14 MCP configs, and 26 companion apps. Trended on GitHub Trending in February 2026 and continues to grow. 2,200 stars.

name: levnikolaevich/claude-code-skills — 505 Stars; hex-line + hex-graph + hex-ssh + hex-research MCP Bundle
hook: A plugin suite built around four hash-verified MCP servers: hex-line (every line carries a content hash so the agent proves it sees current content before editing), hex-graph (AST → deterministic SQLite codebase knowledge graph), hex-ssh (hash-verified remote file editing over SFTP), and hex-research (local markdown hypothesis/task graph). Also ships 7 Agile workflow plugins covering planning, execution, bootstrapping, optimization, and community engagement. v2026.05.06, MIT license. 505 stars.

name: quemsah/awesome-claude-plugins — 926 Stars; n8n Workflow Tracks 24.6k Repos for Plugin Adoption, Updated June 30
hook: An automated n8n workflow indexes 24,586 GitHub repositories for Claude Code plugin adoption and generates a ranked top-100 leaderboard with star counts, subscriber counts, and plugin counts. Updated June 30, 2026. Useful as a live signal of which plugins developers are actually installing, rather than just listing what exists. 926 stars.
